families.product_name: HeartAssist (fetal and adult cardiac AI view classification, segmentation and auto-measurement) on HERA W9/W10, HERA Z20/Z30, V8/V7/V6, V5/V4 systems; AutoEF and Strain+ named in FDA text
families.summary: HeartAssist is a deep-learning function embedded in Samsung Medison ultrasound systems that classifies echocardiographic images into measurement views, segments cardiac structures and proposes measurements. It was first cleared for fetal heart scanning on HERA W10 (K211824, 2021), expanded to adult echocardiography on V8/V7 (K223387, 2023) with automated B-mode, M-mode and Doppler measurements compared against cardiologist ground truth, carried to HERA Z20/Z30 (K241971), V5/V4 (K242511) and HERA W9/W10 (K242444), and its AI models were updated in K250999 (2025). FDA summaries report standalone view-recognition accuracy, Dice scores and measurement error rates on validation sets of 280-888 images; no clinical studies were required and training-set sizes are not disclosed.
families.intended_use_quote: The diagnostic ultrasound system and probes are designed to obtain ultrasound images and analyze body fluids.
families.indications_for_use_quote: The diagnostic ultrasound system and probes are designed to obtain ultrasound images and analyze body fluids. The clinical applications include: Fetal/Obstetrics, Abdominal, Gynecology, Intra-operative, Pediatric, Small Organ, Neonatal Cephalic, Adult Cephalic, Trans-rectal, Trans-vaginal, Muscular-Skeletal (Conventional, Superficial), Urology, Cardiac Adult, Cardiac Pediatric, Thoracic, Trans-esophageal (Cardiac) and Peripheral vessel. It is intended for use by, or by the order of, and under the supervision of, an appropriately trained healthcare professional who is qualified for direct use of medical devices. It can be used in hospitals, private practices, clinics and similar care environment for clinical diagnosis of patients.

embedded_ai_features.name: HeartAssist (fetal)
embedded_ai_features.function: Deep-learning classification of fetal heart ultrasound images into measurement views, segmentation of cardiac structures, and proposed caliper placement / automatic measurements (area, angle, circumference, diameter) that the user can edit. HERA W10 only on the HERA W9/W10 platform. View items later subdivided by cardiac phase (4CV early/end diastole, end systole; LVOT and RVOT systole / end diastole) in K241971; AI model updated in K250999.
embedded_ai_features.quote: HeartAssist is a deep learning based function that provides classification of ultrasound image into measurement views required for fetal heart scanning and provides measurement results. The feature recognizes views and proposes caliper placements and corresponding me asurements allowing users to save time and increase examination efficiency through reducing key-strokes and proposing measurements which can be edited by the user.

embedded_ai_features.name: HeartAssist (adult)
embedded_ai_features.function: Deep-learning adult transthoracic echocardiography view recognition (16 adult heart views per ASE/AIUM in K223387; 18 in K242511), segmentation of heart contours and Doppler signal outlines, and automated measurements in B-mode, M-mode and Doppler mode; auto-measurement evaluated by Pearson correlation against cardiologist measurements. AI model updated in K250999 (adult re-validation not reported there).
embedded_ai_features.quote: The proposed V8 / V7 have included the HeartAssist  which is  based on  the AI version from the previously cleared HERA W9/ HERA W10 (K220043) and expanded the clinical application to adult.

embedded_ai_features.name: AutoEF (with Global Longitudinal Strain)
embedded_ai_features.function: Left-ventricular ejection fraction tool with GLS measurement item added; migrated to V5/cV5, V4/cV4 in K250999 after clearance on V8/cV8, V7/cV7, V6/cV6 (K243702). The FDA summary does not characterize AutoEF as AI/ML and reports no algorithm performance for it.
embedded_ai_features.quote: The proposed V5/cV5, V4/cV4 have updated ‘AutoEF’ function, which was previously cleared in the predicate, by expanding its measurement item to include ‘Global Longitudinal Strain(GLS)’. This change has already been cleared in the predicate device V8/cV8, V7/cV7, V6/cV6 (K243702), and it has been migrated to V5/cV5, V4/cV4.

embedded_ai_features.name: Strain+ (LA and RV)
embedded_ai_features.function: Speckle-tracking strain tool with left atrium and right ventricle measurement items added; migrated to V5/cV5, V4/cV4 in K250999 after clearance in K243702. Not characterized as AI/ML in the FDA summary; no performance reported.
embedded_ai_features.quote: The proposed V5/cV5, V4/cV4 systems have updated the 'Strain+' function, which was previously cleared in the predicate, by expanding its measurement items to include the left atrium (LA) and right ventricle (RV). This change has already been cleared in the  predicate device V8/cV8, V7/cV7, V6/cV6 (K243702) and it has been migrated to V5/cV5, V4/cV4.

training_data.description: No FDA summary in this batch states training-set size; each states only that training, tuning and validation data are completely separated. The peer-reviewed fetal HeartAssist development study (Kim R et al., Sci Rep 2025) reports that 65,324 images from 2,985 fetuses collected at Asan Medical Center (Jan 2016-Oct 2018, GA 20-40 weeks) were analyzed for development and feasibility evaluation; the abstract does not give the train/test split, and it is not stated whether this is the same model version as the cleared device.

validation_data.description: Latest combined adult+fetal FDA validation (K242511): 540 adult static images from 30 individuals (18 adult views, age 20+, BMI 14.88-49.2) and 280 fetal static images from 80 individuals (7 fetal views, GA 17-38 weeks), collected at five hospitals, Americans and Koreans; adult ground truth by two cardiologists and two sonographers with >=10 years' experience. Fetal-only re-validations: K241971 440 images (11 views); K242444 315 static images from 69 individuals (two hospitals); K250999 280 images from 70 patients (26 South Korea, 44 US). K223387: 888 fetal+adult images, five hospitals, only V8 images used. n_patients reflects K242511 (30 adult + 80 fetal).

prior_validations.description: Samsung white paper 'HeartAssist for Adults' (Hyuk-Jae Chang, CONNECT-AI Research Center, Yonsei; PDF dated 2022/11) states HeartAssist is 'an AI software based on a SONIX HEALTH algorithm developed by ON:TACT HEALTH', reports a 93% keystroke reduction for parasternal long-axis LV measurements ('while 14 keystrokes are required ... only a single touch is required (93% keystroke reduction)'), 90% and 83% keystroke reductions for M-mode and Doppler, and per-view acceptance rates for B-mode auto-measurements judged by two experts. Most numeric tables in the PDF use a custom font and could not be reliably extracted.

Samsung 'theSUITE' course page for adult HeartAssist (author Hyuk-Jae Chang, updated 2024-08-29): 20 echocardiographic views; view classification accuracy 'up to 98%'; measurement accuracy '95-100%'; 'reduces manual keystrokes by up to 93% and measurement time by 90%'. No sample size given.

Samsung 'theSUITE' white paper page for fetal HeartAssist (Won HS, Lee MY, Kim R; updated 2024-08-28): 4,000 fetal echocardiograms (GA 20-40 weeks, Asan Medical Center); '95.5% classification accuracy', '100% annotation accuracy', DSC '84.8% for segmentation performance', processing time reduced 'by 87% compared to manual measurements'; 10 views, 44 parameters; supported on WS80A and HERA W10.

Korea Biomedical Review (2023-10-17) on Samsung Medison at ISUOG 2023: 'HeartAssist automatically categorizes and provides results for fetal heart diagnosis by pressing the measurement button.' No performance numbers.

Medical Device Network (2023-02-10) on HERA W10 Elite launch: HeartAssist 'can automatically classify an ultrasound image into measurement views that are needed for fetal heart diagnosis'. No performance numbers.

papers.title: Artificial intelligence based automatic classification, annotation, and measurement of the fetal heart using HeartAssist
papers.key_result: 65,324 images from 2,985 fetuses (GA 20-40 weeks, Asan Medical Center, 2016-2018); CNN classifies 10 views, annotates 26 structures, measures 43 parameters; classification accuracy 99.4% (recall 0.93, precision 0.95, F1 0.94); annotation accuracy 98.4%; automatic measurement success rate 97.6% with error rate 7.62% and caliper similarity 0.613 vs one expert. Two authors affiliated with Samsung Medison AI & Informatics Group; authors declare no competing interests.

papers.title: Evaluation of an artificial intelligent algorithm (Heartassist) to automatically assess the quality of second trimester cardiac views: a prospective study
papers.key_result: Prospective single-center study (Rome), 120 consecutive low-risk singleton pregnancies at 19-23 weeks; agreement between expert sonographer and HeartAssist on view adequacy: Cohen's kappa 0.827 (4CV), 0.814 (LVOT), 0.838 (RVOT), 0.866 (3VT); >87% of images adequate by both methods.

papers.title: EP24.20: Reference ranges of fetal cardiac biometric measurements by HeartAssist in the Korean population: a multicentre prospective study
papers.key_result: ISUOG 2023 congress abstract (electronic poster) establishing Korean-population reference ranges for HeartAssist fetal cardiac measurements; abstract content not retrieved this session.

papers.title: An Artificial Intelligence-Based Automated Echocardiographic Analysis: Enhancing Efficiency and Prognostic Evaluation in Patients With Revascularized STEMI
papers.key_result: Ontact Health Inc. AI system (the developer of the adult HeartAssist algorithm per Samsung's white paper) developed on a five-hospital dataset; in 632 STEMI patients view identification accuracy 98.5%, Pearson r 0.81-0.92 and ICC 0.74-0.90 vs manual LVEF, GLS, LAVI and LA reservoir strain; AI measurements prognostic independent of clinical risk factors. The paper does not name HeartAssist or Samsung; link to the cleared feature is inferred only from the vendor white paper.

open_questions: Training-set sizes for fetal and adult HeartAssist are not disclosed in any FDA summary (K211824-K250999).

Adult HeartAssist auto-measurement performance is reported only as a pass criterion ('Pass if the PCC value is 0.8 or more of spec'); actual Pearson correlation coefficients per measurement are not given in K223387 or K242511.

K250999 updated the HeartAssist AI models for both adult and fetal use, but only the HeartAssist(fetus) validation (280 images, 70 patients) is reported; no adult re-validation appears in the summary.

K250999 fetal view-recognition text says the algorithm 'was validated using 280 fetal biometry images' under the HeartAssist(fetus) heading; likely a copy error for fetal heart images, recorded verbatim.
K241971 states 440 fetal heart images were collected 'at the hospitals' without giving the number of sites or individual patients.
K211824 and K220043 report no quantitative HeartAssist performance; K230084 reports none for HeartAssist (carried over unchanged).

HeartAssist adult and fetal clearance on V8/XV8/XH8, V7/XV7/XH7, V6/XV6/XH6 (K240631) and V8/cV8 (K243702) is asserted by K242511 and K250999, but those predicate summaries (excluded by triage) do not describe HeartAssist.
AutoEF (GLS) and Strain+ (LA/RV) are named in K250999 but are not characterized as AI/ML and have no reported performance; their first clearance K243702 is outside this batch.

Samsung's adult HeartAssist white paper (2022) tables use a custom font; view-classification image counts and per-view accuracies could not be reliably extracted, so only the plain-text keystroke-reduction claims are recorded.

The Samsung course page claims ('up to 98%' view classification, '95-100%' measurement accuracy, 4,000 fetal echocardiograms with 95.5% classification accuracy) carry no sample sizes or methods and are unverified beyond the vendor pages.
Whether the peer-reviewed fetal model (Kim R, Sci Rep 2025; 10 views, 43 parameters) is the same version as the cleared 7-view / 11-view device configuration is not stated.
ClinicalTrials.gov API query for 'HeartAssist' returned no matching studies this session; no registered trial identified.
openFDA lists product code IYN; the FDA summaries also list IYO, ITX and (from K241971 onward) QIH and LLZ.

notes: Single family samsung-heartassist covering 8 included K-numbers (K211824, K220043, K223387, K230084, K241971, K242444, K242511, K250999). Fetal HeartAssist introduced K211824 (HERA W10 only); adult HeartAssist introduced K223387 (V8/V7). Adult quantitative results exist only in K223387 and K242511 (view recognition 98.31%, Dice 0.93; auto-measurement PCC reported as a pass criterion, not values). K250999 updated AI models but reports fetal validation only. AutoEF (GLS) and Strain+ (LA/RV) are named in K250999 but not characterized as AI and have no reported performance; first cleared in K243702 (outside batch). ViewAssist recognizes fetal cardiac views (4CV/LVOT/RVOT) but is an OB annotation feature and was left out of embedded_ai_features. All decision dates and product code IYN match openFDA. Three peer-reviewed performance claims from PMIDs 40240835 and 37097825 are keyed to K211824 (the first fetal HeartAssist clearance) because the papers do not reference a K-number; the adult algorithm developer Ontact Health's KCJ 2024 paper is listed as relation 'other' since it does not name HeartAssist. Company white-paper/course-page numbers are recorded only in prior_validations (no sample sizes). Vendor product pages on samsunghealthcare.com redirect-looped; resources.samsunghealthcare.com/en/cardiovascular used as product_url. No clinical trial registrations found.
